title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE EXTENSION OF THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE TOWNS OF MALINAO AND TIUI, PROVINCE OF ALBAY, FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO TO NOT LATER THAN MARCH FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE EXTENSION OF THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE TOWNS OF MALINAO AND TIUI, PROVINCE OF ALBAY, FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO TO NOT LATER THAN MARCH FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất cho năm 1902 tại các thị trấn Malinao và Tiui, tỉnh Albay đến không muộn hơn ngày 1 tháng 3 năm 1903
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจขยายเวลาการชำระภาษีที่ดินสำหรับปีพ.ศ.2445ในตำบลมาลินาโอและติอูอีจังหวัดอัลบัยถึงไม่ช้ากว่าวันที่1มีนาคมพ.ศ.2446
title.id: Undang-Undang memberi wewenang memperpanjang waktu pembayaran pajak tanah untuk tahun 1902 di kota Malinao dan Tiui, provinsi Albay hingga paling lambat 1 Maret 1903

text.en:
Whereas it has been found impossible to collect the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
two in the towns of Malinao and Tiui, Province of Albay, by the time heretofore designated, the time for the
payment, without penalty, of the land tax in the towns of Malinao and Tiui, Province of Albay, is hereby
extended to not later than March first, nineteen hundred and three, anything in previous Acts to the contrary
nothwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 13, 1903.
